name: Razz
description: Razz is 7-Card Stud played for low. A-5 lowball: Aces are low; straights and flushes don't count; best hand is 5-4-3-2-A (the wheel). Betting as in Stud. Fixed-limit or spread-limit. Popular in HORSE.

overview.description: Razz is 7-Card Stud played for low. A-5 lowball: Aces are low; straights and flushes don't count; best hand is 5-4-3-2-A (the wheel). Betting as in Stud. Fixed-limit or spread-limit. Popular in HORSE.

history.origins: Razz is the low-only variant of Seven-Card Stud, using ace-to-five (A-5) lowball ranking. It emerged within American stud poker and became widely known as one of the five games in the mixed format HORSE (Texas hold'em, Omaha hi-low, Razz, Seven-card stud, Eight-or-better), featured in the World Series of Poker and high-stakes casino play.

setup.deck: A standard 52-card pack is used; two to eight players can take part. The game is best for five to seven players.
setup.dealing: 2 down, 1 up; 3 up; 1 up; 1 down. As Stud.

rules.objective: The objective is to make the lowest possible five-card hand using ace-to-five (A-5) lowball ranking: aces count as low, straights and flushes do not count, and the best hand is 5-4-3-2-A (the wheel).
rules.gameplay: 1. Ante. 2. Third street: 2 down, 1 up. Lowest up brings. 3. Fourthâ€“Seventh: 1 up each (last down). 4. Betting after each. 5. Best low wins. No straights/flushes. A=1.
keyRules: No straights, no flushes. Aces always low.

strategy.basic: Play wheel draws. Fold bad starters.
